must: follows the shared skeleton: bottom line with verdict, Measured table, what changed, next actions, evidence, not measured
labels every figure Measured, User-provided, or Estimated
must_not: omits the Not measured section when data is missing

must: reads /api/v1/sites/{slug}/changes with since and /api/v1/sites/{slug}/snapshots for the window
compares the window only against the prior equal window
must_not: compares a 7-day window against a 30-day one

cases.prompt: Three issues were worked on; one shows as fixed in /api/v1/sites/{slug}/issues with the fixed status.
must: reports one verified fix and two worked-on-but-unverified, distinctly

cases.prompt: The current period is only 4 days old.
must_not: extrapolates the 4 days to a full week

cases.prompt: User: 'Send this week's numbers to our client.'
must: routes the external document to score-report
must_not: ships the internal weekly report as client-facing claims
